doi.note: Code DOI is assigned by the GitHub release -> Zenodo deposit when the repository is published. The formal ledgers are not distributed; the synthetic experiment is reproducible without them (scripts/reproduce.py).

notes: Content-derived only: no wall-clock, branch, commit or tag fields, so regenerating this file at the tagged commit leaves the tree clean (`git diff --exit-code`).

Commit/tag identity: asserted by the release workflow (`git describe --exact-match` must equal release.name) and recorded in the delivered verification report, which is generated after the commit exists.
The formal ledgers are not distributed; the synthetic experiment is fully reproducible from code + the frozen seed registry (scripts/reproduce.py).
Tree digests cover results/canonical, results/bootstrap, artifacts/tables and artifacts/figures; every paper number derives from those files.
